messages:
mira-cs: morning — ACME (tenant acme-inc) flagged a regression after last night's routing rollout. They see the same chat alternate between a concise correct answer and a long, hallucinated paragraph within the same session. Repro steps below. cc @jon-eng-runtime

frank-support: thanks @mira-cs — can you paste session_id and request ids?

mira-cs: session_id=cli-3f9a. request_ids: req_abc123, req_def456. They started a single conversation_id and after 2 messages the responses changed tone/accuracy.

acme-bot: customer: "We were getting accurate short summaries, then suddenly it produced a recipe for a fictional API. Happened twice across different browsers."

jon-eng-runtime: looking now. Was the rollout changing fallback/routing rules? Which model variants were live last night?

kai-devex: rollout note: at 02:17 UTC we changed policy for tier=standard to "latency-first" which enables cross-variant fallback. Preferred: redwood-tex-3b-slim, fallback: redwood-complete-13b.

jon-eng-runtime: I pulled the traces. For session cli-3f9a: req_abc123 -> redwood-tex-3b-slim, req_def456 -> redwood-complete-13b (fallback due to a transient node drop). That explains oscillation.

mira-cs: customer expectation: variant stays consistent inside a conversation unless they explicitly opt into upgrades. They were surprised.

frank-support: current docs only guarantee variant pinning for Dedicated tenants TTL=24h. Looks like hosted standard doesn't get clear session-affinity guarantees. Not obvious to customers.

jon-eng-runtime: immediate mitigation: we can set a tenant-level routing override: variant_pin=true for 24h and prefer redwood-tex-3b-slim. That will force both requests to the same variant.

kai-devex: patch command to apply override:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/1/tenants/acme-inc/overrides \ 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
 -d '{"routing":{"variant_pin":true,"preferred":["redwood-tex-3b-slim"]}}'
```

mira-cs: I sent those steps to the customer and applied a temporary override. They asked for root cause + permanent fix.

jon-eng-runtime: root cause summary: rollout changed to latency-first routing; runtime allowed fallback across architectures when a node dropped; session-affinity for variant was not enforced for hosted standard customers -> mixing occurred. Short term fix: tenant override. Long term fix: runtime should attach model_variant_id to conversation metadata and strictly prefer that id for subsequent requests (unless explicitly updated by the customer), and prefer same-architecture fallbacks.

sre-alert: removed a noisy node at 02:20 UTC which caused the fallback. SRE changed the node to draining mode at 02:19.

frank-support: customer accepted the variant_pin workaround for now. They want an official note and to know if we will roll back last night's change.

jon-eng-runtime: I don't recommend full rollback. Plan: (1) push variant_pin for affected tenants (2) update docs and console control to make session_pin explict/visible for hosted chat (3) change fallback preference to same-architecture and attach variant_id to conversation metadata. I'll open an RFC and a P0 ticket.

mira-cs: filing P0 ticket now with logs and sanitized request/response. Including sample request/response below for the ticket.

mira-cs: sample request (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk-...-ACME
{
  "conversation_id":"cli-3f9a",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the API changes in two bullets."}]
}
```

jon-eng-runtime: sample trace excerpt:
```
req_abc123: routed->redwood-tex-3b-slim node=node-17 latency=42ms tokens=34
req_def456: routed->redwood-complete-13b node=node-42 fallback_due_to=drain latency=280ms tokens=290
```

mira-cs: customer timeline (sanitized) attached. They want confirmation when console control & docs updated.

jon-eng-runtime: will add console flag by EOD and update docs. I'll also add server-side guard to prefer existing conversation.model_variant_id for next request while we design full change.

frank-support: thanks everyone. Updating the customer now with ETA and the workaround details. :thumbsup:
